raw_text: Indian Railways KAVACH signaling system vulnerability disclosure is alarming. The Electronic Interlocking integration uses unencrypted serial comms that could theoretically allow signal manipulation. 4,500 stations affected. This is essentially a SCADA vulnerability in railway signaling. Railway Board reportedly rushing emergency patches for Class A routes first. Anyone have the technical details?
clean_text: Reddit discussion on KAVACH signaling vulnerability. Unencrypted serial communications in Electronic Interlocking across 4,500 stations. SCADA-class vulnerability in railway signaling.
